1.title: Trying to Rid the Pentagon of Culture Wars, Hegseth Has Created His Own
1.summary: Persistent distractions are feeding a climate of mistrust as the U.S. military faces a series of wartime issues, including shortfalls of missile interceptors.

2.title: As Midterms Rage, Gillibrand Wants Congress to Talk Menopause
2.summary: Senator Kirsten Gillibrand of New York is devoting a hearing to a topic that affects millions but is poorly understood and widely ignored, including when it comes to federal research money.

3.title: Alaska Sen. Dan Sullivan Walks a Tricky Line on Tariffs as He Seeks Re-Election
3.summary: Senator Dan Sullivan of Alaska has shown quiet support for President Trump’s tariffs. His brother, the head of their family business, has described the economic volatility as an enormous challenge.

4.title: Meeting Between Iran and Arab States Postponed as Mideast Diplomacy Stalls
4.summary: Talks between the United States and Iran hit a dead end weeks ago, leaving Arab countries struggling to manage their ties to Tehran amid ongoing attacks.

5.title: Landmark Vote Held in Restive Muslim Autonomous Region in the Philippines
5.summary: The election, in an area long known for violent separatists, was marred by a shootout that killed three, officials said.

6.title: The New Moscow: A Digital Utopia Doubling as a Surveillance Trap
6.summary: Cutting-edge technologies have reshaped the Russian capital, making it safer, more convenient — and more closely watched.
